# signoz_data_retention (Data Source)

Fetches the current data retention settings from SigNoz.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read current SigNoz data retention settings.
data "signoz_data_retention" "current" {}

output "metrics_retention_days" {
  value = data.signoz_data_retention.current.metrics_ttl_duration_hrs / 24
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Synthetic ID for the data retention settings. Always "settings".

### Read-Only

- `logs_move_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours before moving logs to cold storage. 0 means disabled.
- `logs_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours to retain logs data.
- `metrics_move_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours before moving metrics to cold storage. 0 means disabled.
- `metrics_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours to retain metrics data.
- `traces_move_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours before moving traces to cold storage. 0 means disabled.
- `traces_ttl_duration_hrs` (Number) Hours to retain traces data.
